killerdogman2010: In Tannenfeld, Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman was a shepherd. In S-F15, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a shepherd again.
The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
souptime13: Day 3: Quentin Souptime reached R-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Quentin Souptime saw Jakub You freeze up on the fire step at Saint-Ash crossroads. Quentin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
souza.fts.085: Edmund Fts came up the line in the rain with a bullet that missed him and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Edmund Fts answered the first call, number 76 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Edmund Fts saved half a biscuit for later. Later turned out to be six minutes away.
Albin Zgz and Edmund Fts divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Edmund Fts folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

During a lull at Saint-Ash crossroads, Dorian Austintress called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Fts answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
